title: 2021 Fall AMC 12B Problem 12
statement: For \(n\) a positive integer, let \(f(n)\) be the quotient obtained when the sum of all positive divisors of \(n\) is divided by \(n.\) For example, \[ \begin{aligned} f(14) &= (1 + 2 + 7 + 14) \div 14 \\ &= \dfrac{12}{7}. \end{aligned} \] What is \(f(768) - f(384)?\)

solutions.text:
Since \(768 = 2^8 \cdot 3,\) its divisor sum is \((2^9 - 1)(1 + 3)\) \(= 511 \cdot 4 = 2044,\) so \(f(768) = \dfrac{2044}{768} = \dfrac{511}{192}.\)

Since \(384 = 2^7 \cdot 3,\) its divisor sum is \((2^8 - 1)(1 + 3)\) \(= 255 \cdot 4 = 1020,\) so \(f(384) = \dfrac{1020}{384} = \dfrac{510}{192}.\)

The difference is \(\dfrac{511 - 510}{192} = \dfrac{1}{192}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Factor \(768 = 2^8 \cdot 3\) and \(384 = 2^7 \cdot 3,\) then use \(\sigma\) of a prime power
Put both over a common denominator of \(192\)
